points.title: Agree on metric definitions first
points.issue: The plan connects systems before agreeing what each metric means, so conflicting definitions will carry over into the new dashboards.
points.suggestion: Add a first step to agree one definition for each key metric with the report users.

points.title: Name data owners
points.issue: No one is responsible for data quality after the project, so problems will return.
points.suggestion: Add a named client-side owner for each key metric before go-live.

points.title: Define success measures
points.issue: There's no way to tell whether the project worked.
points.suggestion: Add two or three measurable outcomes, such as fewer disputes over report figures each month.
